links.outcome: Sleep-staging accuracy after uncertainty-based flagging of predictions for expert review
links.effect: Five-stage sleep-scoring accuracy of a state-of-the-art model increased from 63.9% to 71.2% when uncertain predictions were flagged to clinical experts.
links.quote: This increased the five-stage sleep-scoring accuracy of a state-of-the-art machine learning model from 63.9% to 71.2% on our dataset.

links.outcome: Human expert performance interpreting wearable EEG data compared with ML
links.effect: The ML approach outperformed the human expert, and manual review by sleep specialists without specific training on wearable EEG proved ineffective.
links.quote: Manual review by sleep specialists, without specific training for sleep staging on wearable electroencephalography, proved ineffective.
